body:
Going viral on TikTok brings forth a lot of fabulous opportunities for businesses. Creators put an immense amount of effort into their content just in the hope of going viral.

Other than monetary benefits, businesses or creators get a huge amount of benefits for going viral.

Keep reading to know the comprehensive answer to your question, 'Do You Get Anything for Going Viral on TikTok?'

## Do You Get Anything for Going Viral on TikTok? Described!

TikTok is one of the most used social media platforms in the world. It is estimated that TikTok pays around 2 to 4 cents per 1000 views on videos. It happens due to TikTok's creators' fund.

The more videos you post, the more money you make. The amount is given based on the number of views, the number of content that is being published, the authenticity of the views, and the level of engagement.

When a creator gets a million views on a video, they are supposed to get $20 to $40. Again, a viral video that has 10 million views, is supposed to get $200 to $400.

All the amounts are paid through TikTok's creators' fund. This program is dedicated to paying $300 million to eligible creators. This fund is solely focused on payout for short-form TikTok videos.

All types of videos are not appropriate for the creator fund. Live streams, stitches, duets, or videos made before the acceptance to the creator fund are not eligible for monetization.

## How to Sign Up for TikTok's Creator Fund?

Certain criteria need to be matched to sign up for TikTok's creator fund. [SMMNGen](/) is here to tell you in short!

- The creator must be based in the US, UK, France, Spain, Germany, or Italy.
- They should be at least 18 years old.
- The minimum follower count has to be 10000.
- There should be at least 100000 views in videos in the past 30 days.
- The creator's account must follow the community guidelines of TikTok.

**If you fulfill the above requirements, the next steps are simple.**

1. Log in to your TikTok account.
2. Go to the 'Account Settings'
3. Choose "Creator Tool"
4. Click on "Creator Fund" which is under "Creator Next."
5. Submit your application.

## Pros of Going Viral on TikTok

- **Overnight Fame:** When a video goes viral, the creator instantly gains recognition. Within a few days, they become popular. After that, they won't have to try much to gain visibility. The exposure of the other content also increases significantly. Millions of users from all across the globe will watch your videos and make you a prominent figure.
- **Brand Awareness:** Viral videos create an identity for your brand. As your videos appear on the feeds of people, they get to know about your brand. Curiosity leads them to visit your profile. This elevates the recognition of your brand. People know what type of content you make. It is a win-win deal!
- **Follower Count Increases:** You don't have to worry about your follower count after your videos go viral. After that, people automatically will follow you. Since they will visit your profile frequently, your profile will come to suggestions and videos will appear in "For Your Page." All these will ultimately increase the number of your followers organically.
- **Chances of Monetization:** Once your videos go viral, you can directly get money from TikTok. Other brands try to collaborate or partner up with you. Involve yourself with affiliate marketing. It will also give you a platform to create and sell digital products like your own merchandise. There is also a scope of doing cross-promotion.
- **Confidence Increases:** Going viral means your hard work finally paid off. You start to believe that you are on the right track. You push yourself to make better content. Since people appreciate you, confidence is built up. You give your creativity and talent self-assurance whenever you are on the verge of giving up. It boosts your spirit to a great extent.

## Cons of Going Viral on TikTok

- **Hate Comments or Trolling:** Your audience base increases significantly after going viral. Different types of people will engage with your content. There will be hurtful comments at times. People will criticize you. Don't get bothered or step back. Keep hustling. However, consider the constructive criticisms. Be brave to face them.
- **Temporary Fame:** TikTok constantly becomes full of new challenges and viral videos. Even if you become viral, your video will get replaced by something new after a few days. The views of other content may drop from millions to thousands. If you do not make good content, the audience will forget about you. So, you have to consistently post improved content to maintain the fame.
- **Privacy Concerns:** Going viral means you will get attention from people 24/7. You will receive messages, comments, calls, and whatnot. Sometimes, people may even stalk you in real life. You will enjoy the spotlight for the time being but you will find it hard to balance your personal life amidst it. All these create huge privacy concerns.
- **Copyright or Legal Issues:** Facing copyright or legal issues is a very common phenomenon for creators. If you use copyrighted material or violate the content guidelines of TikTok, a copyright claim may arise. Even your account may get suspended. That's why it is important to navigate the rules and regulations of TikTok.
- **Pressure to Perform:** Your audience will look forward to watching new content from you. If you are unable to meet their expectations, you will get bad comments or lose followers. These factors create pressure to perform. Under such stress, it becomes tiresome to brainstorm new content ideas.

## Conclusion

When you go viral, your audience expects a lot from you. It has its own set of pros and cons. Keeping their expectations in mind, you have to constantly strive for better. If you are trying to make your content viral, you can go for the top 5 [b2b marketing strategies for TikTok ads](/blog/b2b-marketing-strategies-for-tiktok-ads).

Therefore, next time when someone asks, 'Do You Get Anything for Going Viral on TikTok?' Say them a big YES.
